reason: README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that intercepts tool and escalation approval requests, applies deterministic rules and LLM review, supports auto and auto-ask modes, and displays in-memory approval trails; its primary purpose is workflow automation for agent permissions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用提供基于规则和 LLM 审查的自动审批、人工兜底与审批轨迹界面。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness tool-call approval using deterministic rules, LLM review, optional human fallback, and an approval trail interface.

capabilities: Intercepts agent tool and sandbox escalation requests
Applies deterministic allow and deny rules to operations
Uses an LLM classifier for semantic approval decisions
Supports automatic approval and human fallback modes
Can approve one-time requests for wider sandbox execution
Provides an in-memory approval trail UI and settings interface
